purpose: Strong image-text encoder baseline on exactly the P015/P017 Mantis retrieval examples; not new data.
preprocessing: Official model processor, raw captions, max_length64; no tuning or calibration.
permutations: Encode images independently once, reorder scores for the same four cyclic permutations; intrinsic order invariance is not a new method.
comparison: Paired exact-image clusters against both resolutions of P017 raw logits, official-code AGD and patch-only calibrated readout.
decision: If a direct image-text encoder matches or exceeds patch readout, simple caption retrieval alone does not establish a useful LLM/VLM method advantage.
